title: Thai-Style Chinese Sausage Skewers
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring sausage and kabanos, marinated in a fragrant mixture and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together hoisin sauce, fish sauce, rice vinegar, and brown sugar. Add the sausage and kabanos, and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated sausage and kabanos onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with sesame oil and season with salt.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the sausage is cooked through and the kabanos is slightly charred.
During the last 2 minutes of grilling, brush the skewers with a little more sesame oil.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and fresh pineapple chunks.
